benchmark_type_evidence: we introduce MaXIFE: a comprehensive evaluation benchmark designed to assess instruction-following capabilities across 23 different languages with 1667 verifiable instruction tasks.
brief_description: MaXIFE is a multilingual and cross-lingual instruction-following evaluation benchmark covering 23 languages with 1667 verifiable instruction tasks across 47 instruction subcategories, combining rule-based and model-based evaluation strategies.
